risk_note: Taobao order promotion-slot matching per BR-ATTR-02 (platform, union_account_id, site_id, adzone_id) (D10-3338 S0, rule D10-3355): in this App and union account, a registered PID's adzone is the last segment of mm_<a>_<b>_<c> (member/site segments as the registration entry, \d+; adzone as the payload, no leading zero) or the bare digits; a row with that adzone and site_id = the order's site_id is a hit; adzone hits but no site matches -> SITE_MISMATCH (not stored, counted like PID_NOT_OURS, one P1 after commit only, decided before NO_PAY_TIME and BEFORE_SYNC_START); no adzone hit or order without site_id -> PID_NOT_OURS. JD / PDD unchanged. The adapter's slot filter (slotAdzones: listOrders / listPunishments / official search) uses the same function (taobaoAdzoneOf), handed to orders through pids.slotKey (D10-3406). orders.pid of a Taobao hit is the hit row's union_pids.pid, on insert and on update; an unattributed re-sync re-matches by this payload's site_id + adzone and writes the hit row's pid (kept with a warn when nothing hits), so downstream equality lookups (pid_scene, taolijin, first commission snapshot) match (D10-3406 / D10-3454). Frozen support file test/spec/orders/suffix-void-wiring/kit.ts: fixture changed to the real shape by tail-only insertion (ledger patch 1, rule_change BR-ATTR-02, D10-3387). No money arithmetic, no migration, no contract. Recorded out of scope: FU-ORDER-DROP-ALERT-OUTBOX (P1 lost when the COMMIT acknowledgement is lost, needs a table, D10-3454); companion test task B1-08zzd puts the money r2 S0 fixes into rule tests (D10-3454); FU-ORDER-PIDSCENE-REUSE-MATCH (money r3 reviewer out-of-scope S0: an unattributed re-sync keeps only the hit row's pid and re-reads pid_scene by pid, so an admin edit of the same pending row between the two reads loses the taolijin scene; fix = reuse match.row.pid_scene, small implementation task opened right after this lands, D10-3485).
